messages.author: 0b21760319cf3b65
messages.subject: change url - remove port number
parts:
Hi, 


I've seen several questions/answers regarding this "issue", changing the :3838 port number to a decent url. 
I basically need this to show the app (it get's blocked because of the port number).

I have a site in an apache web server and would like to add a shiny app to the directory.
Here is the app current link:
http://marbel.ml:3838/martin/stream_viz/
And would like to access it from http://marbel.ml/shiny/martin/stream_viz/

The following are my apache and shiny conf files. It's based on the other questions/answers in the mailing list. But for some reason it doesn't work. 

This is the relevant part of the site's apache conf file: 

<VirtualHost *:80>

        ServerName marbel.ml

        ServerAlias www.marbel.ml

        ServerAdmin mbtan...@gmail.com

        DocumentRoot /var/www/marbel.ml/public_html


        <Proxy /shiny/>

              Allow from localhost

        </Proxy>


        ProxyPass /shiny/ http://localhost:3838/martin/stream_viz

        ProxyPassReverse /shiny/ http://localhost:3838/shiny/martin/stream_viz

        RedirectMatch permanent ^/shiny$ /shiny/


        ...

</VirtualHost>


This is the shiny conf file:


# Tell Shiny Server that we want to run as the user whose 

# home directory we find the application in.

run_as :HOME_USER:;


# Define a server that listens of port 3838.

server {

  listen 3838;


  # Define a location at the base URL

  location / {

    

    # Allow users to host their own apps in ~/ShinyApps

    user_dirs;


    # Optionally, you can restrict the privilege of hosting Shiny applications

    # only to members of a particular Linux group.

    # members_of shinyUsers;

  }

}



Hope it's clear! 

Thanks. 
Martín

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: change url - remove port number
parts:
Martin,

Try this configuration:

ProxyPass /shiny/ http://localhost:3838/
ProxyPassReverse /shiny/ http://localhost:3838/
ProxyPreserveHost On
ProxyRequests Off
RedirectMatch permanent ^/shiny$ /shiny/

Fereshteh
